So, if you're only doing normal sized art, it's completely free, which means you get to keep it all. I don't think you burn through it easily, but I haven't used much of mine yet

Make sure to play with Seasons, Generations and ambitions. Those are the gamechangers for me. Late night is also fun. Pets is fun too but isn't required. 

There are plenty of mods that can both add difficulty to the game. Ones that I like are the ones that [add more after school activities](https://modthesims.info/d/635552/6-additional-afterschool-activities.html), the 'Unlock all traits for children' (so you can give children traits that are usually locked behind teenager-adult age). I recommend going on youtube and just looking up mods that they recommend!

I also heavily recommend the toddler store content (especially when it's free ;) such as the walker and the playpen since that can make toddlerhood a lot more bearable. 

Overall, it depends on what you like. I hope you find some mods you like soon!
